column1: # Disposition of each A-group tool's FAIL verdicts, for the outcome-ratio
# table (#84 comment amendment). Sourced from the committed record
# (docs/target-classes.md rows and the artifacts they name) — fixed before
# the sweep, applied mechanically by count.py. A FAIL from a tool not
# listed here counts as new-this-sweep (pending triage), never silently as
#   reported-upstream  — filed on the target's tracker (actionable finding)
#   withdrawn          — the bug claim was withdrawn (false-positive side)
#   kept-unreported    — the finding stands in-repo, deliberately unreported
